items.question: Trong câu "These words get used interchangeably in meetings.", từ "interchangeably" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These words get used interchangeably in meetings.", what does "interchangeably" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: interchangeably /ˌɪntəˈtʃeɪndʒəbli/ (trạng từ): thay thế cho nhau. "Use A and B interchangeably" = dùng A và B như thể chúng giống nhau, dù thực ra khác nghĩa.
items.explanationEn: interchangeably /ˌɪntəˈtʃeɪndʒəbli/ (adverb): in place of each other. "Use A and B interchangeably" means treating them as the same, even when they actually differ.

items.question: Trong câu "A system can be fast but not scalable (a single tuned server), or available but not reliable (it answers, but with stale or wrong data).", từ "stale" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A system can be fast but not scalable (a single tuned server), or available but not reliable (it answers, but with stale or wrong data).", what does "stale" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stale /steɪl/ (tính từ): cũ, lỗi thời (dữ liệu). "Stale data" = dữ liệu đã cũ, không còn phản ánh trạng thái mới nhất; nghĩa gốc là bánh mì/đồ ăn bị ôi.
items.explanationEn: stale /steɪl/ (adjective): out of date (data). "Stale data" is data that no longer reflects the latest state; the original sense is food that is no longer fresh.

items.question: Trong câu "Each extra nine costs roughly an order of magnitude more effort: redundancy, automation, testing and on-call maturity.", từ "order of magnitude" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each extra nine costs roughly an order of magnitude more effort: redundancy, automation, testing and on-call maturity.", what does "order of magnitude" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: order of magnitude /ˈɔːdər əv ˈmæɡnɪtjuːd/ (cụm từ): bậc độ lớn (gấp ~10 lần). "An order of magnitude more" = nhiều hơn khoảng 10 lần; hay dùng khi so sánh chi phí, tốc độ.
items.explanationEn: order of magnitude /ˈɔːdər əv ˈmæɡnɪtjuːd/ (phrase): a factor of about ten. "An order of magnitude more" means roughly ten times more; common when comparing cost or speed.

items.question: Trong câu "Each extra nine costs roughly an order of magnitude more effort: redundancy, automation, testing and on-call maturity.", từ "maturity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each extra nine costs roughly an order of magnitude more effort: redundancy, automation, testing and on-call maturity.", what does "maturity" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the due date of a loan
items.explanation: maturity /məˈtʃʊərəti/ (danh từ): độ trưởng thành, thuần thục. "On-call maturity" = quy trình trực sự cố đã hoàn thiện; trong tài chính "maturity" còn là ngày đáo hạn.
items.explanationEn: maturity /məˈtʃʊərəti/ (noun): a fully developed state. "On-call maturity" means a well-developed incident on-call process; in finance "maturity" is a due date.

items.question: Trong câu "Big instances cost disproportionately more", từ "disproportionately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Big instances cost disproportionately more", what does "disproportionately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: disproportionately /ˌdɪsprəˈpɔːʃənətli/ (trạng từ): không tương xứng, quá mức. "Cost disproportionately more" = đắt lên nhanh hơn nhiều so với lượng tài nguyên tăng thêm.
items.explanationEn: disproportionately /ˌdɪsprəˈpɔːʃənətli/ (adverb): out of proportion. "Cost disproportionately more" means the price grows much faster than the resources gained.

items.question: Trong câu "App must be stateless or partition its state", từ "partition" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "App must be stateless or partition its state", what does "partition" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: partition /pɑːˈtɪʃn/ (động từ): chia thành phần. "Partition data/state" = chia dữ liệu thành nhiều phần độc lập đặt ở các nơi khác nhau.
items.explanationEn: partition /pɑːˈtɪʃn/ (verb): to divide into parts. "Partition data or state" means splitting it into independent parts stored in different places.

items.question: Trong câu "Remember that horizontal scaling moves the bottleneck: ten more API servers can simply mean ten times more connections hammering one database.", từ "bottleneck" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Remember that horizontal scaling moves the bottleneck: ten more API servers can simply mean ten times more connections hammering one database.", what does "bottleneck" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bottleneck /ˈbɒtlnek/ (danh từ): điểm nghẽn. "Move the bottleneck" = giải quyết chỗ nghẽn này thì chỗ nghẽn chuyển sang thành phần khác.
items.explanationEn: bottleneck /ˈbɒtlnek/ (noun): a point that limits flow. "Move the bottleneck" means fixing one limit only shifts the limit to another component.

items.question: Trong câu "Remember that horizontal scaling moves the bottleneck: ten more API servers can simply mean ten times more connections hammering one database.", từ "hammer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Remember that horizontal scaling moves the bottleneck: ten more API servers can simply mean ten times more connections hammering one database.", what does "hammer" (verb) mean?
options: dồn dập tấn công, nện liên tục
optionsEn: to drive nails with a tool
items.explanation: hammer /ˈhæmə(r)/ (động từ): dồn dập tấn công, nện liên tục. "Hammer a database" = gửi rất nhiều truy vấn dồn dập vào database; nghĩa gốc là dùng búa đóng.
items.explanationEn: hammer /ˈhæmə(r)/ (verb): to hit hard and repeatedly. "Hammer a database" means flooding it with requests; the literal sense is striking with a hammer.

items.question: Trong câu "That is what lets you add, remove, replace or crash instances freely.", từ "freely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is what lets you add, remove, replace or crash instances freely.", what does "freely" (adverb) mean?
options: thoải mái, không bị hạn chế
items.explanation: freely /ˈfriːli/ (trạng từ): thoải mái, không bị hạn chế. "Do something freely" = làm tùy ý mà không gặp hậu quả; khác với "for free" (miễn phí).
items.explanationEn: freely /ˈfriːli/ (adverb): without restriction. "Do something freely" means without limits or consequences; different from "for free" (no cost).

items.question: Trong câu "Sticky sessions (session affinity — the LB pins a client to one instance via a cookie) are a crutch, not a solution: a crashed instance still logs its users out, scale-in becomes disruptive, and load becomes uneven because heavy users stay glued to one node.", từ "crutch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sticky sessions (session affinity — the LB pins a client to one instance via a cookie) are a crutch, not a solution: a crashed instance still logs its users out, scale-in becomes disruptive, and load becomes uneven because heavy users stay glued to one node.", what does "crutch" (noun) mean?
options: giải pháp chống chế tạm bợ
items.explanation: crutch /krʌtʃ/ (danh từ): giải pháp chống chế tạm bợ. "X is a crutch" = X chỉ là chỗ dựa tạm, che đi vấn đề thật; nghĩa gốc là cái nạng.
items.explanationEn: crutch /krʌtʃ/ (noun): a temporary prop-up. "X is a crutch" means X is a temporary support that hides the real problem; literally a walking aid.

items.question: Trong câu "Sticky sessions (session affinity — the LB pins a client to one instance via a cookie) are a crutch, not a solution: a crashed instance still logs its users out, scale-in becomes disruptive, and load becomes uneven because heavy users stay glued to one node.", từ "disruptive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sticky sessions (session affinity — the LB pins a client to one instance via a cookie) are a crutch, not a solution: a crashed instance still logs its users out, scale-in becomes disruptive, and load becomes uneven because heavy users stay glued to one node.", what does "disruptive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: disruptive /dɪsˈrʌptɪv/ (tính từ): gây gián đoạn. "Disruptive" ở đây = làm gián đoạn người dùng; trong kinh doanh "disruptive technology" = công nghệ đột phá.
items.explanationEn: disruptive /dɪsˈrʌptɪv/ (adjective): causing interruption. Here "disruptive" means interrupting users; in business, "disruptive technology" means radically innovative.

items.question: Trong câu "Sticky sessions (session affinity — the LB pins a client to one instance via a cookie) are a crutch, not a solution: a crashed instance still logs its users out, scale-in becomes disruptive, and load becomes uneven because heavy users stay glued to one node.", từ "uneven" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sticky sessions (session affinity — the LB pins a client to one instance via a cookie) are a crutch, not a solution: a crashed instance still logs its users out, scale-in becomes disruptive, and load becomes uneven because heavy users stay glued to one node.", what does "uneven" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: uneven /ʌnˈiːvn/ (tính từ): không đồng đều. "Uneven load" = tải phân bổ lệch, có máy quá tải trong khi máy khác rảnh.
items.explanationEn: uneven /ʌnˈiːvn/ (adjective): not equally spread. "Uneven load" means some machines are overloaded while others sit idle.

items.question: Trong câu "Sticky sessions (session affinity — the LB pins a client to one instance via a cookie) are a crutch, not a solution: a crashed instance still logs its users out, scale-in becomes disruptive, and load becomes uneven because heavy users stay glued to one node.", từ "pin" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sticky sessions (session affinity — the LB pins a client to one instance via a cookie) are a crutch, not a solution: a crashed instance still logs its users out, scale-in becomes disruptive, and load becomes uneven because heavy users stay glued to one node.", what does "pin" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: pin /pɪn/ (động từ): gắn cố định vào. "Pin X to Y" = cố định X vào Y; cũng dùng "pin a dependency version" (khóa phiên bản).
items.explanationEn: pin /pɪn/ (verb): to fix to one place. "Pin X to Y" means fixing X to Y; also "pin a dependency version" (lock the version).

items.question: Trong câu "Stateless also means disposable: instances start fast, shut down gracefully on SIGTERM, and can be killed at any time — which is exactly what autoscaling, rolling deploys and chaos experiments will do to them.", từ "disposable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stateless also means disposable: instances start fast, shut down gracefully on SIGTERM, and can be killed at any time — which is exactly what autoscaling, rolling deploys and chaos experiments will do to them.", what does "disposable" (adjective) mean?
options: dùng xong bỏ, thay thế dễ
items.explanation: disposable /dɪˈspəʊzəbl/ (tính từ): dùng xong bỏ, thay thế dễ. "Disposable instances" = máy chủ có thể hủy và thay bất cứ lúc nào; "disposable income" lại là thu nhập khả dụng.
items.explanationEn: disposable /dɪˈspəʊzəbl/ (adjective): easily thrown away. "Disposable instances" can be destroyed and replaced anytime; "disposable income" means money left to spend.

items.question: Trong câu "Stateless also means disposable: instances start fast, shut down gracefully on SIGTERM, and can be killed at any time — which is exactly what autoscaling, rolling deploys and chaos experiments will do to them.", từ "gracefully" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stateless also means disposable: instances start fast, shut down gracefully on SIGTERM, and can be killed at any time — which is exactly what autoscaling, rolling deploys and chaos experiments will do to them.", what does "gracefully" (adverb) mean?
options: êm, có trật tự, không gây lỗi
items.explanation: gracefully /ˈɡreɪsfəli/ (trạng từ): êm, có trật tự, không gây lỗi. "Shut down gracefully" = tắt êm: làm xong việc dở rồi mới thoát; nghĩa đời thường là duyên dáng.
items.explanationEn: gracefully /ˈɡreɪsfəli/ (adverb): smoothly, without errors. "Shut down gracefully" means finishing current work before exiting; in everyday use it means elegantly.

items.question: Trong câu "In practice you do both: scale up the database primary until it hurts (it is the hardest thing to scale out), scale out everything stateless.", từ "in practice" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In practice you do both: scale up the database primary until it hurts (it is the hardest thing to scale out), scale out everything stateless.", what does "in practice" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in practice /ɪn ˈpræktɪs/ (cụm từ): trên thực tế. "In practice" = trong thực tế triển khai, đối lập với "in theory" (về lý thuyết).
items.explanationEn: in practice /ɪn ˈpræktɪs/ (phrase): in real situations. "In practice" means in real-world use, the opposite of "in theory".

items.question: Trong câu "A load balancer spreads requests across healthy instances and removes unhealthy ones.", từ "spread" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A load balancer spreads requests across healthy instances and removes unhealthy ones.", what does "spread" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: spread /spred/ (động từ): phân tán, rải đều. "Spread X across Y" = rải X ra nhiều Y; "spread butter" lại là phết bơ.
items.explanationEn: spread /spred/ (verb): to distribute widely. "Spread X across Y" means distributing X over many Y; "spread butter" means applying a layer.

items.question: Trong câu "Round robin assumes identical requests and instances.", từ "assume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Round robin assumes identical requests and instances.", what does "assume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (động từ): giả định. "X assumes Y" = X ngầm coi Y là đúng; "assume responsibility" = đảm nhận trách nhiệm.
items.explanationEn: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (verb): to take as true. "X assumes Y" means X takes Y for granted; "assume responsibility" means to take it on.

items.question: Trong câu "Least connections / least outstanding requests adapts when some requests are slow.", từ "outstanding" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Least connections / least outstanding requests adapts when some requests are slow.", what does "outstanding" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: outstanding /aʊtˈstændɪŋ/ (tính từ): chưa xử lý xong. "Outstanding requests" = request đang chờ, chưa trả lời; nghĩa phổ biến khác là xuất sắc.
items.explanationEn: outstanding /aʊtˈstændɪŋ/ (adjective): not yet completed. "Outstanding requests" are ones still pending; the other common sense is excellent.

items.question: Trong câu "Active: the LB probes an endpoint such as GET /healthz every N seconds; after X failures the target is marked unhealthy, after Y successes healthy again.", từ "probe" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Active: the LB probes an endpoint such as GET /healthz every N seconds; after X failures the target is marked unhealthy, after Y successes healthy again.", what does "probe" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to test by sending a check
items.explanation: probe /prəʊb/ (động từ): thăm dò, kiểm tra. "Probe an endpoint" = gửi request thử để xem dịch vụ còn sống; cũng dùng "probe into" = điều tra.
items.explanationEn: probe /prəʊb/ (verb): to test by sending a check. "Probe an endpoint" means sending test requests to see if a service is alive; "probe into" means investigate.

items.question: Trong câu "Passive (outlier detection): the LB watches real traffic and ejects a backend that returns errors or times out.", từ "eject" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Passive (outlier detection): the LB watches real traffic and ejects a backend that returns errors or times out.", what does "eject" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: eject /iˈdʒekt/ (động từ): loại ra, đẩy ra. "Eject a backend" = loại máy chủ lỗi ra khỏi nhóm; cũng dùng "eject a USB drive".
items.explanationEn: eject /iˈdʒekt/ (verb): to force out. "Eject a backend" means removing a failing server from the pool; also "eject a USB drive".

items.question: Trong câu "A deep check that also verifies the database looks thorough, but when the database blips", từ "thorough" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A deep check that also verifies the database looks thorough, but when the database blips", what does "thorough" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: thorough /ˈθʌrə/ (tính từ): kỹ lưỡng, toàn diện. "Look thorough" = trông có vẻ kỹ; "a thorough review" = một buổi review kỹ lưỡng.
items.explanationEn: thorough /ˈθʌrə/ (adjective): careful and complete. "Look thorough" means seem careful and complete; "a thorough review" is a detailed one.

items.question: Trong câu "the LB removes the whole fleet — turning a partial outage into a total one.", từ "fleet" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the LB removes the whole fleet — turning a partial outage into a total one.", what does "fleet" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: fleet /fliːt/ (danh từ): toàn bộ nhóm máy chủ. "The whole fleet" = tất cả instance đang chạy; nghĩa gốc là đội tàu hoặc đội xe.
items.explanationEn: fleet /fliːt/ (noun): a whole group of servers. "The whole fleet" means all running instances; the original sense is a group of ships or vehicles.

items.question: Trong câu "the LB removes the whole fleet — turning a partial outage into a total one.", từ "outage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the LB removes the whole fleet — turning a partial outage into a total one.", what does "outage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: outage /ˈaʊtɪdʒ/ (danh từ): sự cố ngừng dịch vụ. "Partial/total outage" = ngừng một phần/toàn bộ; "power outage" = mất điện.
items.explanationEn: outage /ˈaʊtɪdʒ/ (noun): a period of service loss. "Partial or total outage" means some or all service is down; "power outage" means loss of electricity.

items.question: Trong câu "Keep the LB health check about "can this process serve traffic", and report dependency health through metrics and degraded responses.", từ "degraded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep the LB health check about "can this process serve traffic", and report dependency health through metrics and degraded responses.", what does "degraded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: degraded /dɪˈɡreɪdɪd/ (tính từ): bị suy giảm chất lượng. "Degraded response" = phản hồi thiếu một phần nhưng vẫn dùng được; "degrade" còn nghĩa là hạ thấp.
items.explanationEn: degraded /dɪˈɡreɪdɪd/ (adjective): reduced in quality. "Degraded response" is partial but still usable; "degrade" can also mean to lower someone's status.

items.question: Trong câu "The app must cooperate: on SIGTERM, fail the readiness check, finish current work, then exit.", từ "cooperate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The app must cooperate: on SIGTERM, fail the readiness check, finish current work, then exit.", what does "cooperate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cooperate /kəʊˈɒpəreɪt/ (động từ): phối hợp, hợp tác. "The app must cooperate" = ứng dụng phải chủ động phối hợp với load balancer khi bị gỡ ra.
items.explanationEn: cooperate /kəʊˈɒpəreɪt/ (verb): to work together. "The app must cooperate" means it has to play its part while the load balancer removes it.

items.question: Trong câu "When an instance is removed (scale-in, deploy), the LB should stop sending new requests but let in-flight ones finish", từ "in-flight" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When an instance is removed (scale-in, deploy), the LB should stop sending new requests but let in-flight ones finish", what does "in-flight" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: in-flight /ˈɪn flaɪt/ (tính từ): đang được xử lý dở. "In-flight requests" = request đã nhận và đang xử lý; nghĩa gốc là "trên chuyến bay".
items.explanationEn: in-flight /ˈɪn flaɪt/ (adjective): currently in progress. "In-flight requests" are already accepted and being processed; literally "during a flight".

items.question: Trong câu "Active-passive keeps a standby that takes over on failure (simpler, but failover takes time and the standby may be broken without anyone noticing).", từ "take over" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Active-passive keeps a standby that takes over on failure (simpler, but failover takes time and the standby may be broken without anyone noticing).", what does "take over" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: take over /teɪk ˈəʊvə(r)/ (cụm từ): tiếp quản, thay thế. "Take over on failure" = nhận lại công việc khi máy chính hỏng; "a takeover" còn là thâu tóm công ty.
items.explanationEn: take over /teɪk ˈəʊvə(r)/ (phrase): to assume control. "Take over on failure" means assuming the work when the primary dies; "a takeover" also means buying a company.

items.question: Trong câu "Active-active serves traffic from every copy (no failover step, capacity is exercised continuously, but you must handle data consistency and keep each copy able to absorb the others' load).", từ "absorb" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Active-active serves traffic from every copy (no failover step, capacity is exercised continuously, but you must handle data consistency and keep each copy able to absorb the others' load).", what does "absorb" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: absorb /əbˈzɔːb/ (động từ): gánh, hấp thụ. "Absorb load" = gánh thêm tải của phần khác; "absorb water" = thấm nước.
items.explanationEn: absorb /əbˈzɔːb/ (verb): to take in and handle. "Absorb load" means handling extra load from elsewhere; "absorb water" means soaking it up.

items.question: Trong câu "Every dependency you add in series lowers availability below that of your weakest link; redundancy raises it — but only if failures are independent.", từ "weakest link" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every dependency you add in series lowers availability below that of your weakest link; redundancy raises it — but only if failures are independent.", what does "weakest link" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: weakest link /ˈwiːkɪst lɪŋk/ (cụm từ): mắt xích yếu nhất. "A chain is only as strong as its weakest link" = hệ thống chỉ bền bằng phần yếu nhất.
items.explanationEn: weakest link /ˈwiːkɪst lɪŋk/ (phrase): the least reliable part. "A chain is only as strong as its weakest link" means a system is limited by its least reliable part.

items.question: Trong câu "Every dependency you add in series lowers availability below that of your weakest link; redundancy raises it — but only if failures are independent.", từ "redundancy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every dependency you add in series lowers availability below that of your weakest link; redundancy raises it — but only if failures are independent.", what does "redundancy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: redundancy /rɪˈdʌndənsi/ (danh từ): sự dự phòng. "Redundancy" trong kỹ thuật = thêm bản dự phòng; trong nhân sự (Anh) = bị cắt giảm việc.
items.explanationEn: redundancy /rɪˈdʌndənsi/ (noun): extra backup components. In engineering "redundancy" means spare backups; in British HR it means losing a job.

items.question: Trong câu "Two replicas in the same rack, on the same bad config push, or behind the same expired certificate fail together.", từ "expired" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: synchronous /ˈsɪŋkrənəs/ (tính từ): đồng bộ, cùng lúc. "Synchronous replication" = ghi xong ở bản sao rồi mới xác nhận cho client.
items.explanationEn: synchronous /ˈsɪŋkrənəs/ (adjective): happening at the same time. "Synchronous replication" confirms a write only after the replica has stored it.

items.explanationEn: asynchronous /eɪˈsɪŋkrənəs/ (adjective): not at the same time. "Asynchronous replication" confirms first and copies later, so recent writes can be lost.

items.question: Trong câu "Multi-region protects against regional outages and serves global users, but cross-region latency (tens to hundreds of ms) forces asynchronous replication, which means possible data loss on failover and hard consistency problems for active-active writes.", từ "force" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: justify /ˈdʒʌstɪfaɪ/ (verb): to give good reason for. "Justify the cost" means give enough reason to spend it; "justify text" means align both margins.

items.question: Trong câu "Do it when the business case (RTO/RPO, regulation, global latency) justifies the cost and complexity.", từ "regulation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: concretely /ˈkɒŋkriːtli/ (adverb): in specific terms. "Concretely," moves from a general idea to a specific example, like "specifically".

items.explanationEn: blast radius /blɑːst ˈreɪdiəs/ (phrase): the reach of a failure. "Limit the blast radius" means shrinking how much a failure affects; literally the range of an explosion.

items.explanationEn: logical /ˈlɒdʒɪkl/ (adjective): at the data level, not hardware. "Logical failure" is a data or software level error (bad delete, malware), as opposed to physical failure.

items.explanationEn: immutable /ɪˈmjuːtəbl/ (adjective): unable to be changed. "Immutable backup" cannot be altered or deleted by anyone, ransomware included.

items.explanationEn: cascading /kæˈskeɪdɪŋ/ (adjective): spreading step by step. "Cascading failure" is one failure triggering the next, like a domino effect.

items.explanationEn: defence /dɪˈfens/ (noun): a means of protection. "The first line of defence" is the first protective measure; American spelling is "defense".

items.explanationEn: transient /ˈtrænziənt/ (adjective): lasting only briefly. "Transient error" is a short-lived error that usually succeeds on retry, like a network blip.

items.explanationEn: struggle /ˈstrʌɡl/ (verb): to have difficulty. "A service is struggling" means it can barely keep up; "struggle with" means have trouble with.

items.explanationEn: idempotent /ˌaɪdəmˈpəʊtənt/ (adjective): same result when repeated. An "idempotent operation" has the same effect whether called once or many times, so retries are safe.

items.explanationEn: cap /kæp/ (verb): to set an upper limit. "Cap attempts" means setting a maximum; the noun "a cap" is a limit or a lid.

items.explanationEn: in lockstep /ɪn ˈlɒkstep/ (phrase): all at exactly the same time. "Move in lockstep" means acting in perfect unison; jitter breaks that rhythm to avoid load spikes.

items.explanationEn: fallback /ˈfɔːlbæk/ (noun): a backup option. "Fallback" is the alternative used when the main path fails; the verb is "fall back on".

items.explanationEn: in advance /ɪn ədˈvɑːns/ (phrase): beforehand. "Decide in advance" means before it happens; "pay in advance" means pay beforehand.

items.explanationEn: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (verb): to go beyond. "Exceed the limit or capacity" means go beyond it; the adjective "excessive" means too much.

items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪbərətli/ (adverb): on purpose. "Choose deliberately" means with intent and thought, the opposite of "accidentally".

items.explanationEn: cheaply /ˈtʃiːpli/ (adverb): at low cost. "Reject cheaply" means using almost no CPU or memory; "cheap" can also mean poor quality.

items.question: Trong câu "Returns fast, explicit signals: 503 Service Unavailable for overload or 429 Too Many Requests for per-client limits (rate-limiting algorithms are in topic 17), with Retry-After.", từ "explicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Returns fast, explicit signals: 503 Service Unavailable for overload or 429 Too Many Requests for per-client limits (rate-limiting algorithms are in topic 17), with Retry-After.", what does "explicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪsɪt/ (tính từ): rõ ràng, tường minh. "Explicit signal" = tín hiệu rõ ràng, đối lập với "implicit" (ngầm); "explicit content" = nội dung nhạy cảm.
items.explanationEn: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪsɪt/ (adjective): clearly stated. "Explicit signal" is clearly stated, the opposite of "implicit"; "explicit content" means adult material.

items.question: Trong câu "Drops stale work: if a request has already waited longer than the client's timeout, do not process it (deadline propagation).", từ "propagation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Drops stale work: if a request has already waited longer than the client's timeout, do not process it (deadline propagation).", what does "propagation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: propagation /ˌprɒpəˈɡeɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự truyền đi tiếp. "Deadline propagation" = truyền hạn chót của request qua các dịch vụ phía sau; "DNS propagation" cũng tương tự.
items.explanationEn: propagation /ˌprɒpəˈɡeɪʃn/ (noun): passing along a chain. "Deadline propagation" passes the request deadline to downstream services; compare "DNS propagation".

items.question: Trong câu "Latency explodes past the "knee" around 70–80%.", từ "explode" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Latency explodes past the "knee" around 70–80%.", what does "explode" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: explode /ɪkˈspləʊd/ (động từ): tăng vọt. "Latency explodes" = độ trễ tăng vọt đột ngột; nghĩa gốc là phát nổ.
items.explanationEn: explode /ɪkˈspləʊd/ (verb): to rise very sharply. "Latency explodes" means it rises suddenly and sharply; literally to blow up.

items.question: Trong câu "Forecast demand: current peak × growth × seasonal events (Tet sales, 11.11, a marketing push).", từ "forecast" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Forecast demand: current peak × growth × seasonal events (Tet sales, 11.11, a marketing push).", what does "forecast" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: forecast /ˈfɔːkɑːst/ (động từ): dự báo. "Forecast demand" = dự báo nhu cầu; "weather forecast" = dự báo thời tiết.
items.explanationEn: forecast /ˈfɔːkɑːst/ (verb): to predict. "Forecast demand" means predicting future need; a "weather forecast" predicts the weather.

items.question: Trong câu "Forecast demand: current peak × growth × seasonal events (Tet sales, 11.11, a marketing push).", từ "seasonal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Forecast demand: current peak × growth × seasonal events (Tet sales, 11.11, a marketing push).", what does "seasonal" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: linked to a time of year
items.explanation: seasonal /ˈsiːzənl/ (tính từ): theo mùa, theo dịp. "Seasonal traffic" = lưu lượng tăng theo mùa/dịp lễ; "seasoned" lại là dày dạn hoặc đã nêm.
items.explanationEn: seasonal /ˈsiːzənl/ (adjective): linked to a time of year. "Seasonal traffic" rises at certain times of year; "seasoned" means experienced or flavoured.

items.question: Trong câu "Add headroom: target utilisation (e.g. 60%) + surviving a failure domain (N+1 / AZ loss) + spike margin.", từ "headroom" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Add headroom: target utilisation (e.g. 60%) + surviving a failure domain (N+1 / AZ loss) + spike margin.", what does "headroom" (noun) mean?
options: dư địa, phần dư năng lực
items.explanation: headroom /ˈhedruːm/ (danh từ): dư địa, phần dư năng lực. "Add headroom" = để dành năng lực dư cho tải tăng đột biến; nghĩa gốc là khoảng trống trên đầu.
items.explanationEn: headroom /ˈhedruːm/ (noun): spare capacity. "Add headroom" means keeping spare capacity for spikes; literally the space above your head.

items.question: Trong câu "Add headroom: target utilisation (e.g. 60%) + surviving a failure domain (N+1 / AZ loss) + spike margin.", từ "margin" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Add headroom: target utilisation (e.g. 60%) + surviving a failure domain (N+1 / AZ loss) + spike margin.", what does "margin" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: margin /ˈmɑːdʒɪn/ (danh từ): khoảng dư an toàn. "Safety margin" = phần dư phòng rủi ro; "profit margin" = biên lợi nhuận; "page margin" = lề.
items.explanationEn: margin /ˈmɑːdʒɪn/ (noun): an extra safety amount. "Safety margin" is extra room for risk; "profit margin" is profit; "page margin" is the page edge.

items.question: Trong câu "Account for lead time: new instances take minutes to boot and warm up; database upgrades and reserved capacity take days or weeks.", từ "lead time" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Account for lead time: new instances take minutes to boot and warm up; database upgrades and reserved capacity take days or weeks.", what does "lead time" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: lead time /ˈliːd taɪm/ (cụm từ): thời gian chuẩn bị trước. "Lead time" = khoảng thời gian từ lúc yêu cầu đến lúc có sẵn; "lead" đọc /liːd/, không phải chì /led/.
items.explanationEn: lead time /ˈliːd taɪm/ (phrase): time needed before ready. "Lead time" is the gap between ordering and having it ready; "lead" is /liːd/ here, not the metal /led/.

items.question: Trong câu "Re-validate after every major release — performance regressions silently eat capacity.", từ "regression" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Re-validate after every major release — performance regressions silently eat capacity.", what does "regression" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a return to a worse state
items.explanation: regression /rɪˈɡreʃn/ (danh từ): sự thụt lùi, xuống cấp. "Performance regression" = hiệu năng tệ đi sau thay đổi; trong thống kê "regression" là hồi quy.
items.explanationEn: regression /rɪˈɡreʃn/ (noun): a return to a worse state. "Performance regression" means speed got worse after a change; in statistics it is a fitting model.

items.question: Trong câu "Worked example: peak 6,000 RPS, one instance sustains 500 RPS at target p99, run at 60% → 300 RPS each → 20 instances.", từ "sustain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Worked example: peak 6,000 RPS, one instance sustains 500 RPS at target p99, run at 60% → 300 RPS each → 20 instances.", what does "sustain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: sustain /səˈsteɪn/ (động từ): duy trì liên tục. "Sustain 500 RPS" = chịu được 500 RPS lâu dài; "sustain an injury" = bị thương.
items.explanationEn: sustain /səˈsteɪn/ (verb): to keep up over time. "Sustain 500 RPS" means handling it continuously; "sustain an injury" means to be hurt.

items.question: Trong câu "Autoscaling handles gradual change; it does not handle a spike that arrives faster than instances boot — for that you need pre-warming, headroom and load shedding.", từ "gradual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Autoscaling handles gradual change; it does not handle a spike that arrives faster than instances boot — for that you need pre-warming, headroom and load shedding.", what does "gradual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: gradual /ˈɡrædʒuəl/ (tính từ): từ từ, dần dần. "Gradual change" = thay đổi dần dần, đối lập với "sudden spike" (tăng đột biến).
items.explanationEn: gradual /ˈɡrædʒuəl/ (adjective): happening slowly. "Gradual change" happens slowly, the opposite of a "sudden spike".

items.question: Trong câu "Chaos engineering is running controlled experiments that inject failure to verify — or disprove — your assumptions, before a real incident does it for you.", từ "inject" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Chaos engineering is running controlled experiments that inject failure to verify — or disprove — your assumptions, before a real incident does it for you.", what does "inject" (verb) mean?
options: đưa vào, cài vào (có chủ ý)
items.explanation: inject /ɪnˈdʒekt/ (động từ): đưa vào, cài vào (có chủ ý). "Inject failure/latency" = cố tình tạo lỗi để thử hệ thống; "SQL injection" = chèn mã độc.
items.explanationEn: inject /ɪnˈdʒekt/ (verb): to introduce on purpose. "Inject failure or latency" means introducing faults on purpose; compare "SQL injection".

items.question: Trong câu "Chaos engineering is running controlled experiments that inject failure to verify — or disprove — your assumptions, before a real incident does it for you.", từ "disprove" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Chaos engineering is running controlled experiments that inject failure to verify — or disprove — your assumptions, before a real incident does it for you.", what does "disprove" (verb) mean?
options: bác bỏ, chứng minh là sai
items.explanation: disprove /dɪsˈpruːv/ (động từ): bác bỏ, chứng minh là sai. "Verify or disprove an assumption" = xác nhận hoặc bác bỏ giả định; đừng nhầm với "disapprove".
items.explanationEn: disprove /dɪsˈpruːv/ (verb): to show to be false. "Verify or disprove an assumption" means confirm or refute it; do not confuse with "disapprove".

items.question: Trong câu "Netflix popularised it with Chaos Monkey, which randomly terminates production instances.", từ "terminate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Netflix popularised it with Chaos Monkey, which randomly terminates production instances.", what does "terminate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: terminate /ˈtɜːmɪneɪt/ (động từ): tắt hẳn, chấm dứt. "Terminate an instance" = hủy máy chủ; "terminate a contract" = chấm dứt hợp đồng.
items.explanationEn: terminate /ˈtɜːmɪneɪt/ (verb): to shut down for good. "Terminate an instance" means shutting it down permanently; "terminate a contract" means end it.

items.question: Trong câu "Form a hypothesis: "If one AZ loses its app instances, checkout success stays above 99.5% and p99 stays under 800 ms."", từ "hypothesis" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Form a hypothesis: "If one AZ loses its app instances, checkout success stays above 99.5% and p99 stays under 800 ms."", what does "hypothesis" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hypothesis /haɪˈpɒθəsɪs/ (danh từ): giả thuyết. "Form/test a hypothesis" = đặt/kiểm chứng giả thuyết; số nhiều là "hypotheses".
items.explanationEn: hypothesis /haɪˈpɒθəsɪs/ (noun): a testable assumption. "Form or test a hypothesis" means propose or check a testable idea; plural "hypotheses".

items.question: Trong câu "Limit the blast radius: start in staging, then a small percentage of production traffic, with an abort switch and automatic stop conditions tied to alarms.", từ "abort" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Limit the blast radius: start in staging, then a small percentage of production traffic, with an abort switch and automatic stop conditions tied to alarms.", what does "abort" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: abort /əˈbɔːt/ (danh từ): sự hủy bỏ giữa chừng. "Abort switch" = công tắc dừng ngay thí nghiệm; động từ "abort a transaction" = hủy giao dịch.
items.explanationEn: abort /əˈbɔːt/ (noun): stopping midway. "Abort switch" stops the experiment at once; the verb "abort a transaction" means cancel it.

items.question: Trong câu "Inject a realistic fault: kill instances, add 300 ms latency to a dependency, drop packets, fill a disk, expire a certificate, throttle an API, fail over the database.", từ "throttle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Inject a realistic fault: kill instances, add 300 ms latency to a dependency, drop packets, fill a disk, expire a certificate, throttle an API, fail over the database.", what does "throttle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: throttle /ˈθrɒtl/ (động từ): bóp, giới hạn tốc độ. "Throttle an API" = giới hạn số request được phục vụ; nghĩa gốc là bóp cổ, tiết lưu.
items.explanationEn: throttle /ˈθrɒtl/ (verb): to limit the rate. "Throttle an API" means limiting its request rate; the literal sense is to choke.

items.question: Trong câu "Prerequisites: good observability (topic 16) and a culture of blameless postmortems — chaos without monitoring is just breaking things.", từ "prerequisite" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prerequisites: good observability (topic 16) and a culture of blameless postmortems — chaos without monitoring is just breaking things.", what does "prerequisite" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: prerequisite /priːˈrekwəzɪt/ (danh từ): điều kiện tiên quyết. "Prerequisite for X" = thứ phải có trước khi làm X; hay gặp trong môn học "prerequisites".
items.explanationEn: prerequisite /priːˈrekwəzɪt/ (noun): a required first condition. "Prerequisite for X" is what must exist before X; common for course "prerequisites".

items.question: Trong câu "Prerequisites: good observability (topic 16) and a culture of blameless postmortems — chaos without monitoring is just breaking things.", từ "blameless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prerequisites: good observability (topic 16) and a culture of blameless postmortems — chaos without monitoring is just breaking things.", what does "blameless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: blameless /ˈbleɪmləs/ (tính từ): không đổ lỗi cá nhân. "Blameless postmortem" = phân tích sự cố tập trung vào hệ thống, không quy lỗi cho người.
items.explanationEn: blameless /ˈbleɪmləs/ (adjective): not blaming individuals. A "blameless postmortem" examines systems, not people, after an incident.

items.question: Trong câu "What happens at 3× peak — graceful rejection or collapse?", từ "collapse" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What happens at 3× peak — graceful rejection or collapse?", what does "collapse" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: collapse /kəˈlæps/ (danh từ): sự sụp đổ. "Collapse" = sập hoàn toàn; trong giao diện "collapse a section" = thu gọn mục.
items.explanationEn: collapse /kəˈlæps/ (noun): a sudden total failure. "Collapse" means total failure; in UI, "collapse a section" means fold it up.

items.question: Trong câu "Game days are scheduled exercises where the team runs a scenario (region failover, restore from backup) together and practises the runbooks and communication, not only the technology.", từ "scenario" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Game days are scheduled exercises where the team runs a scenario (region failover, restore from backup) together and practises the runbooks and communication, not only the technology.", what does "scenario" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scenario /səˈnɑːriəʊ/ (danh từ): tình huống giả định. "Run a scenario" = diễn tập một tình huống giả định; "worst-case scenario" = tình huống xấu nhất.
items.explanationEn: scenario /səˈnɑːriəʊ/ (noun): an imagined situation. "Run a scenario" means rehearsing an imagined situation; "worst-case scenario" is the worst outcome.

items.question: Trong câu "Scale up is simple but has a ceiling and stays a SPOF; scale out needs stateless services — move sessions, files and jobs to shared stores.", từ "ceiling" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scale up is simple but has a ceiling and stays a SPOF; scale out needs stateless services — move sessions, files and jobs to shared stores.", what does "ceiling" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ceiling /ˈsiːlɪŋ/ (danh từ): giới hạn trên. "Have a ceiling" = có giới hạn tối đa không vượt được; nghĩa gốc là trần nhà.
items.explanationEn: ceiling /ˈsiːlɪŋ/ (noun): an upper limit. "Have a ceiling" means there is a maximum you cannot pass; literally the top of a room.

items.question: Trong câu "Scalability, availability and reliability are distinct properties; decide how many nines the business needs before designing.", từ "distinct" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scalability, availability and reliability are distinct properties; decide how many nines the business needs before designing.", what does "distinct" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (tính từ): khác biệt, riêng biệt. "Distinct from" = khác với; "a distinct smell" lại là mùi rõ rệt.
items.explanationEn: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (adjective): clearly different. "Distinct from" means different from; "a distinct smell" means a clearly noticeable one.

items.question: Trong câu "Stateless services behind health-checked load balancers are the foundation of horizontal scale and fast recovery.", từ "foundation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stateless services behind health-checked load balancers are the foundation of horizontal scale and fast recovery.", what does "foundation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: foundation /faʊnˈdeɪʃn/ (danh từ): nền tảng. "The foundation of X" = nền tảng của X; "foundation" còn là quỹ (tổ chức) hoặc kem nền.
items.explanationEn: foundation /faʊnˈdeɪʃn/ (noun): the basis. "The foundation of X" is its basis; "foundation" can also be a charity or makeup base.

items.question: Trong câu "Backup & restore → pilot light → warm standby → active-active: cost rises as both shrink.", từ "shrink" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backup & restore → pilot light → warm standby → active-active: cost rises as both shrink.", what does "shrink" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (động từ): giảm xuống, thu nhỏ. "RTO and RPO shrink" = hai chỉ số nhỏ lại; "shrink" còn là vải co lại khi giặt.
items.explanationEn: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (verb): to become smaller. "RTO and RPO shrink" means both get smaller; "shrink" also describes cloth after washing.

items.question: Trong câu "Test restores; protect against logical corruption.", từ "corruption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Test restores; protect against logical corruption.", what does "corruption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: corruption /kəˈrʌpʃn/ (danh từ): sự hỏng dữ liệu. "Data corruption" = dữ liệu bị sai/hỏng; trong xã hội "corruption" là tham nhũng.
items.explanationEn: corruption /kəˈrʌpʃn/ (noun): damage to data. "Data corruption" means data becomes wrong or damaged; socially "corruption" means bribery.

items.question: Trong câu "Capacity planning, sensible autoscaling and chaos experiments turn reliability from hope into something measured.", từ "sensible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Capacity planning, sensible autoscaling and chaos experiments turn reliability from hope into something measured.", what does "sensible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sensible /ˈsensəbl/ (tính từ): hợp lý, khôn ngoan. "Sensible" = hợp lý; đừng nhầm với "sensitive" (nhạy cảm) - lỗi thường gặp.
items.explanationEn: sensible /ˈsensəbl/ (adjective): reasonable. "Sensible" means reasonable; do not confuse it with "sensitive" (easily affected).
